title: Local Class & Event Schedule Data Cleaner
target_pain: Converting messy, unformatted dance studio schedules, workshop listings, and local activity text into structured CSV, JSON, and ICS calendar files with automatic time standardization, genre tagging, and deduplication.
key_features: Smart Multi-Format Parsing (Raw Text, Pipe Delimited, Messy CSV & TSV)
Automatic Genre Tagging (Hip-Hop, Breaking, House, Heels, Jazz, Yoga, etc.) & Level Extraction
Time Format Standardizer (12-Hour AM/PM <-> 24-Hour ISO Normalization)
Automatic Duplicate Removal & Instructor / Address Field Normalization
One-Click Real Exports (Download Clean CSV, JSON Data, iCalendar .ICS File, or Copy to Clipboard)
